title: DiagnosticsReport
description: Diagnostics report for the player (W1703 rule 4, Bogen 35 R11): versions, self-check, hardware tier, model states and the last errors from the logs, as Markdown. It contains no tokens and no user paths and stays on the computer: the service writes it into its log folder, and the player passes it on only if they want to. POST /diagnostics.

file_name.description: Name of the report file in the service's log folder (no path).
